name: Claude-Red
description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
one_liner: A library of expert 'playbooks' that teach an AI assistant how to think like a professional penetration tester, covering specific attack techniques for authorized security testing.
buyer: A boutique penetration-testing firm or freelance security consultant who wants to deliver authorized security assessments faster with AI assistance.
business_use_cases: A freelance security consultant uses it to speed up authorized penetration tests for small-business clients who can't afford big-firm rates.
A security training company builds a course teaching AI-assisted red-teaming methodology using the skill library as course material.
An MSP adds 'AI-augmented security assessment' as a new, lower-cost service tier for existing clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer discounted AI-augmented penetration testing engagements to small businesses priced out of traditional pentest firms.
Sell premium, regularly-updated skill packs to security professionals as a subscription.

steal_this: Launch a boutique 'AI-augmented pentest for small business' service this weekend — but this only works with a genuinely qualified security operator behind it; the tool accelerates a professional, it doesn't replace one.
